sort -u temp_checks/matches_checked.txt > temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt

if grep -q ": regular file" temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt; then
    echo "true" > temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag
else
    echo "false" > temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag
fi

echo "Summary: found_regular_file.flag is $(cat temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag). See temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt for details." > temp_checks/summary.txt
"}
